title: Spectral densities from Euclidean correlators via integral transforms: theoretical framework
summary: Spectral densities link experimental measurements to dynamical properties of a quantum field theory which, in turn, can be resolved non-perturbatively from the Euclidean time-dependence of correlation functions. By making extensive use of integral transforms, we present analytic formulae to carry out the inverse Laplace transform so as to extract spectral densities from either the continuum or the discrete sampling of correlation functions in the Euclidean time.
